3.name: third person
3.plain: anyone or anything else: he, she, it, they

PL.name: plural
PL.plain: more than one; on verbs, the suffix -t that makes a person plural

NOM.name: nominative
NOM.plain: the bare case in -i: the subject in the present, the object in the past, and the thing named

DAT.name: dative
DAT.plain: the case in -s: the object in the present, the person to whom, the experiencer of feeling verbs, and the doer in the perfect

SBJ.name: subject marker
SBJ.plain: a verb prefix or suffix (v-, -s, -a, -en, -es and others) that agrees with the verb's subject-set person

OBJ.name: object marker
OBJ.plain: a verb prefix (m-, g-, gv-, zero) that agrees with the verb's object-set person, which for feeling verbs and in the perfect is the experiencer or doer

IMPF.name: imperfect
IMPF.plain: the screeve for what was going on or used to happen, marked by -d- with its endings

PV.name: preverb
PV.plain: the prefix in front of the verb that adds direction and makes the future, aorist and perfect complete

TS.name: thematic suffix
TS.plain: the suffix (-eb, -ob, -av, -am, -i) that builds the present and future stem and drops in other series

PASS.name: passive or intransitive marker
PASS.plain: the prefix i- or suffix -d- that turns a doing verb into a happening verb

AOR.name: aorist
AOR.plain: the screeve for a completed past event, and the source of the command form

ERG.name: ergative
ERG.plain: the case in -ma or -m of the doer of a transitive or medial verb in the aorist and optative

GEN.name: genitive
GEN.plain: the case in -is: of, belonging to, and the base for many postpositions

INS.name: instrumental
INS.plain: the case in -it: with, by means of

ADV.name: adverbial
ADV.plain: the case in -ad: as, into, in the role of

VOC.name: vocative
VOC.plain: the form for calling someone: -o or -v

OPT.name: optative
OPT.plain: the screeve for wishes, suggestions and should, used after unda and rom

IO.name: indirect object
IO.plain: a verb prefix (s-, h- or zero) marking a third person to or for whom something happens

NV.name: neutral version
NV.plain: the vowel a- in front of the root, saying nothing about whom the action is for

SV.name: subjective version
SV.plain: the vowel i- in front of the root: the action is for the subject itself

OV.name: objective version
OV.plain: the vowel u- (third person) or i- (first and second) in front of the root: the action is for someone else, or belongs to them

PRF.name: perfect
PRF.plain: the screeve of series III for what has (apparently) been done, with the doer in the dative

PLUP.name: pluperfect
PLUP.plain: the second screeve of series III: had done, or should have done

PTCP.name: participle
PTCP.plain: an adjective made from a verb: the past participle in -il or -ul, and the others when unmarked

FUT.name: future
FUT.plain: in this guide only in FUT.PTCP, the participle in sa- for what is to be done; future screeve forms are glossed by their preverb

PRIV.name: privative
PRIV.plain: the participle in u- ... -el or -ar: not done, un-

MSD.name: masdar
MSD.plain: the verbal noun, the form a verb is named by: c̣era 'writing'

REL.name: relativiser
REL.plain: the suffix -c that turns a question word into a relative word: vin 'who?', vinc 'who (that)'

SBJV.name: subjunctive
SBJV.plain: the screeves in -de (present and future subjunctive), used in some subordinate clauses

CAUS.name: causative
CAUS.plain: the suffix -in in a- ... -in-eb that makes 'make someone do'

LV.name: locative version
LV.plain: the vowel a- in front of the root meaning 'on, over' something

OBL.name: oblique
OBL.plain: the short form of a demonstrative before a noun in any case but the nominative: am, mag, im
